The structure of Sc₂MnCu crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with a unit cell containing 16 atoms (Sc₈Mn₄Cu₄) distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived coordination analysis shows Cu and Mn each surrounded by eight Sc neighbors, while Sc has eight neighbors (four Cu and four Mn), all at 2.7453 Å and described as body-centered-cubic-like local arrangements. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 16 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner- and face-sharing between Cu and Mn 8-vertex polyhedra, and edge-sharing among like-centered polyhedra.
